facts.fact: A doctrinal study in the East African Journal of Law and Ethics (Josephina John), published 24 August 2026 (no other date given), finds Tanzania's legal framework on cross-border data transfers progressive on paper but incomplete in practice, with institutional capacity and enforcement gaps, and cites the Personal Data Protection Act Cap. 44 R.E. 2023 and the Data Protection (Collection and Processing Personal Data) Regulations, GN No. 349 of 2023.

note: Abstract and reference list only; it states no list of countries, published means of complying or named enforcement action.
